sourceNote: LibriTTS corpus speakers.tsv (READER/GENDER/SUBSET/NAME), mirrored in LINE's promptttspp data_prep; cross-checked reader-for-reader against the LibriSpeech SPEAKERS.TXT lineage (raw.githubusercontent.com/nii-yamagishilab/SSL-SAS/main/data/libritts_train_other_500/SPEAKERS.txt) with zero gender disagreements. Piper index map from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/en/en_US/libritts_r/medium/en_US-libritts_r-medium.onnx.json Reader NAME column ("n") added 2026-07-24 verbatim from the same speakers.tsv NAME field, whitespace-trimmed only.

acoustics.sampleText: The gate was already open when the riders came.
acoustics.method: server-synthesized sample per speaker; autocorrelation median f0 + envelope syllable rate; pitch buckets = within-gender f0 terciles, rate = global sps terciles, 'lively' = top tercile of f0 movement
